title: Area formula through Φ composed with an injective C¹ change of variables χ
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P K-Lipschitz and c-antilipschitz on Ω for some K ≥ 0 and c > 0 (c|w − w′| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w′)| for w, w′ ∈ Ω). Let B ⊆ ℝⁿ be open and χ : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ of class C¹ on B and injective on B, with χ(B) ⊆ Ω. Let S ⊆ χ(B) be Borel and ψ : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] Borel. Put S′ := B ∩ χ⁻¹(S) and JΦ(w) := √det(⟨DΦ(w)e_i, DΦ(w)e_j⟩)_{i,j<n}, where D = fderiv ℝ and e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Then ∫_{Φ(S)} ψ dHⁿ = ∫_{ℝⁿ} 1_{S′}(y)·ofReal|det Dχ(y)|·ψ(Φ(χ y))·ofReal(JΦ(χ y)) dLⁿ(y), with Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^P and Lⁿ := volume on ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (B : Set (Eucl n)) (χ : Eucl n → Eucl n) (S : Set (Eucl n)) (ψ : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen Ω → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ B → InjOn χ B → χ '' B ⊆ Ω → MeasurableSet S → S ⊆ χ '' B → Measurable ψ → ∫⁻ x in Φ '' S, ψ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫⁻ y, (B ∩ χ ⁻¹' S).indicator (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal |(fderiv ℝ χ y).det| * (ψ (Φ (χ y)) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ (χ y) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ (χ y) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det))) y ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n))
